name: SS Clinic
product_facts: Clinics: Subang Jaya and Kota Bharu
Consultations, health checks, telehealth, personal care plans
Approach: check first, assessment before any treatment
color_rules: 60:30:10 (navy foundation, white/clinical navy structure, gold accent)
Gold on Clinical Navy: large text and shapes only

fonts.body: Inter on the web, 15 px, 1.7 line height

rules: Never retype the wordmark; use supplied files
Text on solid panels, not on busy photos
Clear space and minimum size still to be confirmed

photography: Dignified Malaysian men aged 32 to 55, warm clinic lighting, natural eye contact, health-check equipment in use. Real clinic photography with written consent only.
avoid: Promises to cure, or to work by a certain time
False urgency such as countdowns or 'last slots'
Images of distressed men or pill bottles
Showing or naming individual doctors in brand material
doctor_allowed_in_ads: yes, in Educational mode only: real SS Clinic doctor, organic educational posts, identified with a lower third (name and title), no clinic CTA. Never in clinic advertisements (KOL ad mode). Head of Creative decisions 2026-10-16 and 2026-10-21.
source: SuamiSihat Design System repo (static/products/<slug>/metadata.json, docs/claims-review/README.md and audit-2026-10-13.md), plus brand guideline v1.0 PDFs (16 Oct 2026)
staff_claims_review: Permanently blacklisted SS Clinic copy (brand-voice.md, SSC-STR-001): 'Mati pucuk', 'Lemah batin', 'Pancut awal', 'Keras dalam 1 sesi!'
Prescription medicines (e.g. tadalafil under ANDROLAB RX) cannot be advertised to the public in Malaysia; keep RX content internal
Compliant alternatives: 'Penurunan tenaga lelaki', 'Kesihatan intim lelaki', 'Vitaliti suami', 'Stamina dan daya tahan'

decision_log.decided_by: Head of Creative (Muhammad Harussani Adul Manap)
decision_log.decision: Allow doctor on screen for SS Clinic educational videos, with a lower third "Dr Rak, Men's Health Doctor". Only doctors from SS Clinic may appear. Dr Rak is head of doctors at SuamiSihat Healthcare Sdn Bhd.
decision_log.unchanged: banned_terms, review_terms and the claims review (TBC) still apply. End card line: 'Kami Check & Rawat'.
decision_log.open: Guideline v1.0 still says do not show or name individual doctors; update it so it matches. Doctor consent reference not on file.

decision_log.decided_by: Head of Creative (Muhammad Harussani Adul Manap)
decision_log.decision: Guideline wording to read: only doctors from SS Clinic are allowed in SS Clinic videos. The engine now enforces this through appointed_doctors.

decision_log.decided_by: Head of Creative (Muhammad Harussani Adul Manap)
decision_log.decision: SS Clinic content runs in two modes. Educational (default): real SS Clinic doctor in organic educational posts, no clinic CTA. KOL ad: clinic advertisements are presented by a hired KOL, never a real doctor, with KKLIU approval per posting.
decision_log.reason: MAB Policy and Decision (Services) 12/2007, amended 1/2025: no doctors in clinic advertisements. MMC Guideline V2/2025 3.2, 6.5: no patient solicitation by doctors. Act 290 s.4A.
decision_log.replaces: End card line 'Kami Check & Rawat' and CTA 'Datang ke SS Clinic' on doctor videos (2026-10-16). Not to be used in Educational mode.
decision_log.open: Adviser to confirm whether clinic-page posting or the clinic logo makes an Educational video an advertisement, and the exact neutral closing line.

standing_notice: SS Clinic decision log 2026-10-21: Educational mode (default) = real doctor, no clinic CTA, no offer or testimonial. KOL ad mode = KOL only, KKLIU number per posting. Claims guidance is still TBC.
end_card_line: Educational mode: neutral close only (no clinic CTA). KOL ad mode: wording as approved in the KKLIU application. 'Kami Check & Rawat' retired for doctor videos 2026-10-21.

logo_files.note: file names follow the design system: 'light' = for light backgrounds, 'dark' = for dark backgrounds

educational.who: Real SS Clinic doctor (appointed_doctors). Uniform or plain clothes; always identified as a doctor on screen.
allowed: Evidence-based teaching on men's health topics
Lower third with name and title
Neutral close such as 'Jumpa doktor untuk pemeriksaan jika ada simptom'
not_allowed: Any line or end card sending viewers to SS Clinic (e.g. 'kita check dan rawat di SS Clinic', 'Datang ke SS Clinic')
Booking links, prices, offers or discounts
Testimonials, quote popups or proof screenshots
Superlatives or promoting the doctor's skill or experience
educational.open: Whether posting from the SS Clinic page or showing the clinic logo counts as advertising: ask the adviser or MAB in writing.

kol_ad.who: Hired KOL. Never a real doctor (MAB policy 12/2007, amended 1/2025).
requires: KKLIU approval number for EACH posting before it runs (MAB allows one format per application)
MAB illustrative statement on screen if anyone portrays a doctor or patient
allowed: KOL speaking about the premises and the visit experience
Clinic CTA as approved in the KKLIU application
not_allowed: Testimonials about treatment results or a doctor's skill
